blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government has ordered telecom firms in the Philippines to strengthen checks on subscribers with many registered SIM cards to prevent illicit activities like scams. In a statement, the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) said it gave mobile network operators 15 days from receipt of order to conduct additional verification of subscribers with more than 100 SIMs registered under a single name. READ: Most cybercrimes still tied to SIM cards despite law – PNP As a result, telcos must perform know your customer (KYC) checks to ensure that registered subscribers control their SIMs and are used for legitimate purposes.
